principles: Only material inside the exact approved scope is mapped; nothing is summarised, rewritten or invented.

Every mapped element keeps its REVFORGE identifier, its source references (permanent SYS-/FIL-/PATH-/SEC-/PAR-/STMT-/REC-/FLD- IDs), the sha256 of the record it came from and, for run-local catalogue IDs (BR-/GAP-/DEC-), the source run that issued it.
Each mapped input is written with a provenance sidecar (<name>.provenance.json, contract bmad/provenance) that the output validator re-checks before a result is accepted.

Runtime requirements are mapped and counted separately from business requirements, and every requirement, data contract and decision carries its inclusion class (direct, shared_dependency, cross_scope, global) and reason from the scope reconciliation (STEP 7).

BMAD-PRD.name: approved-requirements
BMAD-PRD.from: scope requirements (accepted F1 receipts) and their G2 outcomes
BMAD-PRD.bmad_input: PRD functional requirements (one FR per REVFORGE requirement ID)

BMAD-PRD.name: business-rules
BMAD-PRD.from: canonical rule register entries of the scope

BMAD-PRD.name: data-contracts
BMAD-PRD.from: accepted F2 data_record and file_operations items of the scope

BMAD-PRD.name: decisions
BMAD-PRD.from: signed decision resolutions that affect the scope

BMAD-PRD.name: approval
BMAD-PRD.from: the signed G2 approval bound to the scope digest

BMAD-ARCH.name: runtime-requirements
BMAD-ARCH.from: accepted F1 runtime_requirement items of the scope

BMAD-EPICS.name: architecture
BMAD-EPICS.from: recorded BMAD-ARCH / F3 results of the scope

BMAD-SPRINT.name: stories
BMAD-SPRINT.from: recorded BMAD-EPICS / F4 results approved at G4

BMAD-REVIEW.name: implementation
BMAD-REVIEW.from: recorded BMAD-BUILD / F5 results (files and sha256)
